groups.name: Start here
groups.blurb: Small Beginner puzzles (5×5 and 6×6) that introduce the core white and black circle rules.

groups.name: Default
groups.blurb: Standard Masyu boards by size — from quick 6×6 warm-ups up to giant 18×18 and 12×20 grids, easiest first.

groups.name: Bonus
groups.blurb: Themed variations using the exact same rules with a distinct feel.

All white.blurb: Every circle is white: straight lines and forced turns everywhere.

All black.blurb: Every circle is black: sharp corners and long two-step legs.

Sparse.blurb: Stripped down to as few circles as uniqueness allows.

Skyscraper.blurb: Tall, narrow towers (up to 6×30) where the loop snakes up and down.

Exact symmetry.blurb: Mirror, diagonal-mirror, 180°, and 90° rotational puzzles where both clues and solution loop are symmetric.

Yin-Yang.blurb: 180° opposite-color symmetry: turn the board upside down and every white circle lands on a black circle.

No edge clues.blurb: Zero circles on the outer border — no free wall openings, work outward from the interior.

Lattice.blurb: Every even row and even column holds a circle — all dots present, and none anywhere else.

Full board.blurb: Every single intersection on the grid is visited by the loop (100% fill, standard Masyu rules).
